answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks 40 POA, then must keep a work pulse for 10 epochs: one verified job per epoch, with a fingerprint of timing and task mix. Each job adds one pearl-like layer and unlocks 4 POA. Faking 100 copies costs 4,000 POA plus 100 fingerprints; slips forfeit the lock under an onyx seal of failed checks. An honest agent pays once and recovers its escrow plus undiluted rewards.
